lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Last time on Dragon Ball Z Abridged...

lines.speaker: Krillin
lines.text: WAH! WAH! WA--!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, out of *all* the people I've blown to bits, that one will hold a special place in my heart.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (Shakes/grunts in anger)

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh, what's wrong, monkey? Come on now, give me something funny.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You... killed my best friend...!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Ha! That is pretty funny. Hilarious, actually.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: RRAAAAAAAAAGGGHHHHHHHH!!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What?!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Dad?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: HM!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: That's... that's not funny.
High pitch signal

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I don't believe it! Goku has truly done it. He has become... the one and only Super Saiyan™!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: ...Right?

lines.speaker: Narrator
lines.text: Y...yeah...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: You hesitated there for a second.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: ...What?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What the hell is all this about?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What's up with your hair? What's up with your eyes?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Answer me!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Take Piccolo, find Bulma, get back to the ship.

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: But what about you?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If Piccolo dies, then all this was pointless! Take him, get to the ship, and get out of here!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: This is surprisingly well-thought-out for you.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Gohan, where should you be right now?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: The ship?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *The SHIP*!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: OK!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Oh-ho, real cute. But at the very least, I do love a moving target.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hurrh!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Gah! What are you--... let go of me!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I'm going to *break* you...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What?
CRUNCH

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: AAH!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...like a Kit-Kat™ bar.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ...*What*?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: D'AAAGH!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: '*What*?!'
CRUNCH

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: GAAAAAH!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You... you're different!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What happened? What the hell are *you*?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Can't you tell, Freezer? It's just like Vegeta said.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: No, you f***ing *don't*...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am the hope of the Omniverse!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am the lightbulb in the darkness!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am the bacon in the fridge for all living things that cry out in hunger!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am the Alpha and the Amiga!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I am the terror that flaps in the night!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I... AM SON GOKU!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: AND I AM A SUPER--!
BING

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Hurrrurrrgh...!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: ...Saiyan.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: HurrriURRRRGH!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: (Gasping in disbelief)

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: King Kai! What's going on on Namek right now?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: You know you could always just grab my shoulder and watch.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Yeah, but, you kinda... smell...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: That's just my natural musk.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Mmmmusk...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Mmmmmmmusk...

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Stop saying "musk".

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Stop eating my food!

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: King Kai, do you hear me?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Oh, hey Kami. How's everything coming along?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Well, I've sent off Mr. Popo to collect the Dragon Balls like you asked.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Good. The whole plan is coming together.

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: Hey, I don't think you ever told us your plan.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I don't have to tell you everything! I don't have to tell you anything!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: And that just about sums up our time spent here.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Ha ha...

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Huh? It's the ship!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: See, Mr. Piccolo - we're halfway home!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: I mean, not literally, but... just don't bleed out, okay?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'God, so many buttons...!'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: 'I forgot, I don't know how to fly the ship! I could have sworn somebody did that for--'

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Oh my God, Bulma!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Help?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: ...Somebody?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I have to admit, this is new, monkey! This is definitely new!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: But a monkey is still a monkey, and I've killed plenty in my day.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: *Millions*. Literally, *millions*.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: What's the matter, run out of quips? Cat got your tongue?! No more words to fail?!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: You think now that you're this, so-called "Super Saiyan", that you're *better* than me, *Lord Freeza*?!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Well, you're NOT!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I own you! I own your planet! I own THIS planet! In fact...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: F*** THIS PLANET!!!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Wait, I zoned out there for a second. Wha--?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: No... *no*, *no*, son of a bitch! Daaarrgghh...!

lines.speaker: Yamcha
lines.text: What's wrong, King Kai?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: You dumb assholes are gonna be here forever!

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Tch, yeah, real funny, King Kai.

lines.speaker: Tien
lines.text: Oh God, you're serious.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I had this whole plan ready to go, but, as it turns out, Freeza's a sore loser, and just--

lines.speaker: Chiaotzu
lines.text: Blew himself up along with his opponent?

lines.speaker: Chiaotzu
lines.text: What? It's what I do.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Yeah, only this time, it *worked*.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: And now Goku, Gohan, Piccolo... everyone's dead!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: And I'm stuck with you idiots for the rest of my life!

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Should I call you back when you're done screaming? Or is that just not happening?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: And then there's *this* c--...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Kami?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Yes, I wanted to inform you that Mr. Popo has acquired the sixth Dragon Ball an--

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: You're alive?!

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: So this is what counts for omnipotence these days, hmm?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: But if you're not dead, then that means Piccolo's not dead, and Namek is still there!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: D...didya miss?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: How could I miss?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I dunno, how didya?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I know I hit the core. God, this always happens when I try and perform under stress.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Seems to me like you just couldn't go through with blowing us *both* up.

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: That's not the problem, you idiot. I can breathe in space.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: (Gasp)... But space is a vac-uum!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Honestly, I'd say you only have... I don't know... five min--... is it five?

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Y-yes, five!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Five minutes before this planet explodes, and you perish along with it.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Well then, I'll just have to kill you in four!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Wait, hold on! I-I'm only at half my full power.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I don't see how that's my problem...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: No, listen! If you let me power up...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I'll give you a pizza!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: You killed my best friend, Freezer. That's not gonna work anymore!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Two pizzas!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: I SAID I'M *DONE*! HAAAAA...!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: ...With stuffed crust.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: *Gokuuuu...!*

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Now, hear me out, King Kai.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: If I let him power up to 100%, and beat him *then*... it'll demoramalize him! And he'll never threaten anyone again!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Goku, that is retarded!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: *Stuffed crust*, King Kai! You can eat it in *reverse*!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I-I can't even believe we're having this conversation...

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Me either...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Thanks for waiting, by the way.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Hold on one second, King Kai. What was tha--?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huhh!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: Smash monkey!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: SMASH MONKEY!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Bulmaaa... where are you?

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: (Unearthly eldritch sounds)

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Oh, well how nice of you to finally come and get me... only you left me stranded all on my own to fend for myself!

lines.speaker: Bulma
lines.text: Planet's going to hell, I almost die, and I'M FREAKING THE F*** OUT!

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: Bulma, how high would you have to fall from to hit terminal velocity?

lines.speaker: Gohan
lines.text: ...I thought so.

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Huaagh!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I just love how easy it is to get away with this s*** with you people!

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: I want to transform, you just sit there and let me. I want to blow the planet up, you just sit there and let me! I want to reach 100% power...

lines.speaker: Freeza
lines.text: *and you just sit right there and let me*!

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Sooo, can I get a Meat Lover's®?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: OW!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: And that is my star pupil.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: I don't even know why I bother.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: King Kai, are you there?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Oh Kami, d'you have an update for me?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Apparently it's all I'm good for anymore...

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: I wanted to tell you that Mr. Popo has acquired the final Dragon Ball and is ready to summon the Dragon.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Awesome, now let me talk to him.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Heh, if you insist.

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Alright, now Mr. Pop-- oaarrggh!

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: How the hell do you work with this guy??

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: It's easier than you think...

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: I'm so f***ing high right now!

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: I am the Eternal Dragon. Speak your wish and I sha--

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: ...oh. It is you, my Master. Is it time to lay waste to this world?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Eh, not yet. Give 'em a couple hundred years. See if they can clean this up.

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: Then how might I be of service, Lord Popo?

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Good question. Kami, the f*** am I doing?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Good question. King Kai, the f*** is he doing?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Ow, my head...

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: OK, listen. I want you to bring back everyone Freeza and his men have killed.

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Why?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Are you questioning God?

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Are *you*?

lines.speaker: King Kai
lines.text: Not in the mood, Kami!

lines.speaker: Kami
lines.text: Fine, not my problem anyway. Mr. Popo--

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: I heard.

lines.speaker: Mr. Popo
lines.text: Dragon, bring back all the worthless maggots that were killed by Freeza and his men, or whatever...

lines.speaker: Shenron
lines.text: As you command, so it shall be.
